title: Fake Boarding Pass App
scenario: A pop-up says you need a new app to display your boarding pass.

answers.A: Open the airline app or website you already use.
answers.B: Install the new app from the pop-up and grant it access.
answers.C: Ask the airline desk to print or verify the boarding pass.
answers.D: Search the app store and install the first result with the airline name.

explanation: A boarding pass is already available through the airline known channels. A pop-up can push a fake app or excessive permissions.
proTip: Use the airline app you chose, not one a pop-up chooses for you.
